title: What SignalRig is, and isn't.
what: SignalRig is a working demonstration of GTM engineering, built by one person to show how I approach the work: which systems to build, in what order, and the judgement that goes into each. It is not a company with clients, and nothing here is a client claim.

The code and the logic are real and run in your browser. The companies, replies, signals and reporting numbers are invented sample data, labelled as such on every demo. Swap the JSON for a real ICP and the same systems run on it.

steps.note: Try kestrelhq.com, then marrowbio.com. Watch the waterfall get skipped.

steps.note: Then turn decay off and see a stale account climb.

steps.label: Split the report by segment × persona
steps.note: Two cells carry sixteen. The aggregate hides it.

facts.v: Next.js 16, TypeScript, Tailwind v4. No backend, no tracking, no API calls.
Eleven JSON files. Every demo, card and checklist reads from them, so the pitch changes without touching React.
Designed, built, screenshot-tested at desktop and phone widths, and deployed in one working session, with Claude Code as the build partner and me directing the architecture, data and copy.
Keyboard operable, reduced-motion aware, colours validated for colour-vision separation on the dark surface.
